endpoints.unit: Targets averaged within each source record, eligible records averaged within identical code, codes equally weighted. Each subgroup recomputes these denominators. Neural family estimates average individual seed performances.
endpoints.metric: Exact reference endpoint on explicit STOP. Crash and cap rates are separate. Rates and differences are fractions.

uncertainty.method: Paired exact-program percentile bootstrap; population unit is code. The maximum over all fixed simple methods is reselected in every draw. Intervals describe test-program variation conditional on fitted policies.

preregistered_correspondence_diagnostic.definition: original MetricPolicy.predict, before the support-label vote
